extracted.name: Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: These Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies are made from scratch and are essentially large chocolate chip cookies that are extra thick and chewy.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups light brown sugar (, firmly packed)
2 cups chocolate chips ((I use 1 cup mini chocolate chips and 1 cup chocolate chunks )
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375 F. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or silplat mat.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in medium bowl; set aside.
Add butter, sugar and brown sugar to a large mixing bowl or stand mixer and beat well until creamed together
Add eggs and vanilla and mix until combined
Gradually mix in the flour and mix until combined
Use a 1/4 cup measuring cup to scoop spoonfuls of dough onto prepared cooke sheet, about 2 inches apart
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or just until light golden brown around the edges. (Do not over bake.)
Let stand 1 minute on cookie sheet, then transfer to cooling rack to cool completely
